convert_videomae_checkpoint: convert a VideoMAE checkpoint from the original repository to a Hugging Face PyTorch model
get_videomae_config: get a VideoMAE config for a given model name including architecture and label mappings
rename_key: rename a state dict key from the original VideoMAE checkpoint format to Hugging Face format
convert_state_dict: convert an original VideoMAE state dict to Hugging Face VideoMAE state dict format
set_architecture_configs: set architecture config parameters like hidden size and layers based on model variant
